input.task: Use the mcp__tessl__search tool to find the most relevant skill for implementing a Node.js REST API. Search for something like "node api" or "hexagonal architecture node". Pick the best result based on its description and scores. Install it using mcp__tessl__install (or fall back to running `tessl install <package> --skill <name>` via Bash if the MCP tool is unavailable). Once installed, use the skill to implement a simple Node.js API in a hex-api/ directory that translates English text to hex — a single POST /translate endpoint. Also add a one-shot bash script (run-and-test.sh) that starts the server and fires a curl request against it.
